subject: DIB Training workshops in the fall quarter

messages.author: ac39d8d6e7bb1699
messages.subject: DIB Training workshops in the fall quarter
parts:
Hi all,

I’ve posted a list of training workshops for data intensive biology that I’ll be running in the fall quarter. They’re open to all and are free to attend. I haven’t opened up registration for all of them yet but when I do, I will notify the dib-training mailing list. For details and/or to join the mailing list, please visit the Web site:

https://dib-training.readthedocs.io/en/pub/

All workshops are introductory and require no prior experience; they’re all ~3 hours long & in the morning, and will be held in the Valley Hall building over on the Health Sciences side of campus.

best,
—titus

workshop dates:

October 20th, 2016 - Open Refine for working with large spreadsheets.

November 1, 2016 - Introductory version control with git.

November 17th, 2016 - Amazon Web Services for cloud computing.

November 29th, 2016 - Introduction to UNIX shell

December 6th, 2016 - Open Refine for working with large spreadsheets.

December 8th, 2016 - Introductory version control with git.

December 13th, 2016 - Amazon Web Services for cloud computing.

December 15th, 2016 - R, RStudio, and RMarkdown for exploring your data.

December 20th, 2016 - Jupyter Notebook for exploring your data.
